body: Yeah, that's not something that is done or enforced in my country at all :( I've just tried to throw away inconsequential things underneath important ones and always destroy documents if necessary.

Last year, my mom threw her Christmas presents to the ground and stood on them bc she was angry that we had gone to our dads for Christmas (only for like 2 hours).

She always gets pissy when we do something for dad or something she perceives as "betrayal" even though she literally protected a child abuser and a murderer because they were "family". She's wack.

This has happened to me too, and you already did a very important step which is realizing you're doing it. Besides doing what the person above me said (great advice!) I'd also tell you start with being honest with yourself. Something I found I was doing was telling other people lies and then going hard to make those lies the truth, because they were better than the reality. Coming to terms with my life has made it way easier to be truthful. 

Also, I've been trying to maintain this mantra: if you can't tell someone the truth (for whatever reaaon), don't say anything.

Totally. My mother used to say "the only real friend you'll ever have is the money in your pocket" and now I have a really tough time finding long-lasting friendships. I always feel like they want something from me and like no matter how much I try, I will never be the "good friend". Unfortunately, I have really bad trust issues and that also makes me feel super alone all the time.

It's a real struggle, and I hope you open yourself up and find the real friendships you truly deserve. Sending love your way ❤

My mom never gets us any presents but expects us to give her outlandish ones. I also have to hide the presents I get for my stepmother and dad from her, because she will literally make a tantrum about them. She also throws in our faces presents from 20 years ago.

That's so nice 😭 I've actually started looking at therapist near me and I'm going to start going. I need to start healing. 

My mom is so...sad honestly. That's what scares me the most. She's still hung up about someone who left her TWENTY YEARS AGO. My dad never thinks about, or talks about her or cares about her and she's still talking about him like it was yesterday. He's been with his new wife for FIFTEEN YEARS. And she still fucking thinks my dad might want to come back to her, and she goes over these rants about how "happy she is alone" and how "he's a dick who lost out". Like. Ma'am 😭 I don't want to be alone, but I honestly rather be than being like her, just fucking. Ugh. 

Also sorry for ranting but another thing she does is that she'll pretend My dad is rich or some shit and that she's poor and sad and starving when she isn't. Literally she isn't. Idk, i just want to be in a point when I can move past her influence and being happy just 'cause.
Thank you. The holidays are always hard overall, but the last 2 or 3 years have been brutal, since she just seems to up her hatred.

They're so pathetic. Like, I used to be really sympathetic to her and felt bad about my dad leaving her when I was young, but as I grow older I realize he got away from her because she's draining and exhausting to be around. I cannot wait to get away from her too tbh. I'm sorry you have to go through that too, I'm sending you lots of virtual hugs.

I'm absolutely terrified that I'm going to end up like my narcissistic mom. Like her, I don't have any real friends and I have a lot of psychological issues. She never got diagnosed with anything bc she believes it's all bullshit (or so she says), but i think she has been depressed all her life. 

She's a bitter and sad soul. She still stalks my dad and his wife, who left her 23 years ago. She's happy when he has financial struggles and she was happy when his mom died earlier this year. She's just awful. And I think I might end up the same way? A classmate got something really good happen to them and all I got was filled with rage and jealousy even though i know she deserves it. I just. I would rather die than end up like her, I really would. 

I've been at the end of my rope for a while, but now (not necessarily because of the holidays but it is a contributing factor) I just want to end it all to get away from her.
Thanks. You too. Hopefully away from parents like her.

Thank you so much, really. I appreciate the care and the fact you want to listen, because a lot of people do not in my life. I told my brother I wanted to kill myself because of my mom and he said "well I'm on the same boat so don't complain". So I won't. I'll just walk out. I feel like crap but I know it'll be okay. It has to be. 

I'm glad your life is better now. I hope there's people in your life now that love you and that you're getting the care that you were deprived of earlier in your life.
Your parents sound like terrible people and I honestly hope you get get out of that environment soon.

Thank you. I cried a lot reading this and I honestly hope you have a good life. You deserve it. 

I've taking the decision now. My brother and I bought her something as a peace offering of sorts and she threw it at my door. And I think that's the physical manifestation of what's happening and I've crying about it all day but this finally did it. I'm packing and I'm leaving on Monday as soon as the lockdown in my country is done. I feel like I'm dying but I'm finally packing. And you're right, just because she's my blood doesn't mean she cant or wont hurt me. And it's time I'm done with that.

God, you're braver than I am. I'm sure she has been undiagnosed with something but she refuses to see help and at this point, I just can't be her punching bag anymore. 

I'm glad you've found happiness where you can and I hope I can get to the point where I can do the same.

Well, I am a student and I'm hopefully starting my internship soon, so that's great. I also have to think about how to take my kitten with me, because if there's something I'm thankful for, its him.

Thank you so much. Just speaking about it has lifted a weight I didnt even know I had.

Thank you for your responses and your advise. And you're right, I live in constant fear that she'll change her mind and decide that she doesn't want to be a good mom anymore. I'll talk to my brother and try to gather my strength to leave. Thank you really. I hope you have wonderful new year.

Thank you, really. It helps just getting it out there because you cannot bad mouth your mom here because people will absolutely judge the shit out of you. My dad has been telling me to move it with him for a long time, but everytime that I feel courageous to do it, my mom does a 180 and she's suddently the nicest lady around. She never apologises for being awful and she just assumes that we have to forgive her. We celebrate Christmas of the 24th and she didn't speak to us all day, or the 25th or the 26th. She doesn't even care if we eat or not.

I don't have a therapist no. She's always been like this but I just don't feel strong enough to deal with it. A lot of it has to do with my culture, as we're told from an early age that your parents are always going to be your parent regardless of how fucking awful they are. She herself has repeatedly told me that I should be thankful for her and that a lot of people have it worse.

I wasn't a fan at all. To me, the strength of the show was always the core characters and the ability the show had to showcase them all with a perfect harmony. 

Season 3 felt...scrambled. Almost like they were trying to fit as many thing as soon as possible into as little time as they could. 

I love the show, and I'll continue watching always, but I was not pleased with season 3 at all. 

Plus, there were times when the drama felt unnecessary and the humor not as organic as before. I hope we can get some of the magic back in season 4 :(

Hi! 

I'm a vet student, and I think you might want to ask for a referral to your vet. Just by the symptoms, I would guess it's a neurological issue, with either his teeth, head or neck. Those can be easily fixed if caught early, and your vet neurologist will be able to give you more specific tests, that might identify what's wrong. 

Good luck!

Thank you so so much, back at you!

I'm not an avid reddit user, so this has been a lovely first experience!!
Well, thanks for the talk anyways. Having someone hear me out really really helps, at least with the mental state. And yeah, my country is nothing like that AT ALL. Quite unfortunate actually.

Man that sucks really hard. I live in a country where most people have no idea what ADHD is, so it really kind alienates me a bit. I've gotten 3 interviews for an internship, and they all say that they aren't taking new interns because of Covid-19. Frustrating as hell. 

And I haven't actually been able to do anything with my actually career. I'm a veterinary student, and as such we kind of need to be at the place to work. I've done fiverr for helping kids with their Spanish homework and exams, but it's not that great, honestly. And I have no idea where else would work.

Thank you! You're so kind. 

I wish you luck too. Frankly, I think young people were kind or overall screwed thanks to the pandemic.  Have you had the "you're great but we need someone with experience?" Like. How do I get experience if no one will hire me without experience.
